usedFor: Browse AI scrapes web tables and Salesforce stores contacts, so “Table Export” can feed “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Table Export” in Browse AI, then “Create Contact” in Salesforce
bestTemplate.why: A finished table export turns scraped details into a Salesforce contact, ready for follow-up.

watchOut: “Create Contact” only helps if the exported table carries contact details, so check the columns before connecting.
